Initially presented in hand, the bread slice is a static object, yet full of potential. As it is inserted into the toaster, there is a transition from potential to process—the bread begins its transformation. This sequence is a snapshot of everyday life, a familiar action paused in time and broken down into the individual steps that lead to the satisfying crunch of a freshly toasted slice of bread.
